item.title: What Every Music Company Made in Q2 2026 (Updating)
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to 'The Beat'! We're diving into the world of music earnings, and it's shaping up to be an exciting season. Let's take a look at the latest results from the major players in the industry."
[Music transitions to a smooth, upbeat tune]
Host: "Sony Music is off to a strong start, with revenue surging 20% year-over-year. Warner Music Group saw a 10% uptick in quarterly revenue, thanks to double-digit subscription streaming growth. But Universal Music Group didn't quite hit the right note, with a 25% decline in its share price due to disappointing growth margins."
[Music transitions to a K-pop-inspired beat]
Host: "Meanwhile, in Korea, HYBE is thriving, thanks to the massive success of BTS' world tour and their latest album, ARIRANG. And in live music, Live Nation is killing it, with a significant increase in quarterly revenue despite some stiff competition from FIFA World Cup games."
[Music transitions to a mellow, acoustic tune]
Host: "Satellite radio giant SiriusXM is finding its footing with low-cost companion plans and premium channels featuring big names like Morgan Wallen and Green Day. And streaming service Deezer is seeing slight increases in revenue and adjusted gross profit."
[Music transitions back to the intro tune]
Host: "We're not done yet! Spotify reports its earnings on Tuesday, and we'll be keeping an eye on those results. Stay tuned for more updates as the earnings season continues. That's all for now – thanks for tuning in to 'The Beat'!"
[Outro music plays]
